facts.fact: The median annual pay for fitness trainers and instructors was $47,160 in May 2025.
facts.quote: The median annual wage for fitness trainers and instructors was $47,160 in May 2025.

facts.fact: The 2025 median pay for fitness trainers and instructors was $22.67 per hour.
The number of fitness trainer and instructor jobs in 2025 was 388,400.
Employment of fitness trainers and instructors is projected to grow 7 percent from 2025 to 2035, which the page describes as much faster than the average for all occupations.
facts.quote: Employment of fitness trainers and instructors is projected to grow 7 percent from 2025 to 2035, much faster than the average for all occupations.

facts.fact: Employment of fitness trainers and instructors is projected to change by 28,500 jobs from 2025 to 2035.
About 68,000 openings for fitness trainers and instructors are projected each year, on average, over the decade from 2025 to 2035.
facts.quote: About 68,000 openings for fitness trainers and instructors are projected each year, on average, over the decade.

facts.fact: The typical entry-level education for fitness trainers and instructors is a high school diploma or equivalent.
The typical work experience in a related occupation required for fitness trainers and instructors is none.

facts.fact: The typical on-the-job training for fitness trainers and instructors is short-term on-the-job training.
Employers prefer to hire fitness trainers and instructors who have certification, though education and training requirements vary by specialty.
